sentences.text:
Dhananjay Singh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 8 April,
2025
 Neutral Citation No. 2025:Mphc-Jbp:17019
 1 
 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
At Jabalpur

Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Pramod Kumar Agrawal
 On The 8 th Of April, 2025
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 15362 of 2025
 Dhananjay Singh
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh
 Appearance:
 Shri Rakesh Dwivedi - Advocate for applicant.
 Shri Atmaram Bain - Government Advocate for State.

Order 
This is the first application under Section 483 of B.N.S.S./439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of bail in connection with Crime No.19/2025 registered at Police Station - Mahila Thana, District Singrauli (M.P.) for offence punishable under Sections 376, 376(2)(n) and 506-II of IPC.
The applicant is in custody since 01.03.2025.
2. As per the prosecution story, the allegation against present applicant is of committing rape with the prosecutrix on the pretext of marriage.
On the basis of which, offence has been registered against the present applicant under the aforesaid sections.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present case.
He is in custody since 01.03.2025.
The prosecutrix is aged about 27 years.
She is consenting party.
It is further submitted that FIR has been lodged with some delay.
There is no proper explanation of delayed FIR.
Charge sheet has been filed.
There is no criminal record of applicant.
The conclusion of the trial will take considerable time, therefore, it has been prayed that the applicant may be released on bail.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:17019 2 MCRC-15362-2025 4.
Learned counsel for the respondent/State has opposed the bail application and prayed for it's rejection.

sentences.text: Having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case, but without commenting on merit of the case, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.

Consequently, bail application under Section 483 of B.N.S.S./439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant,
stands allowed.

6. It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of BNSS.
7.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
